title: No Pilots. Few Air Traffic Controllers. What Could Go Wrong?
summary: Normally, aviation is slow to embrace new technology—but AI has come for the skies.
llm_summary: A looming shortage of pilots and air‑traffic controllers is pushing the aviation industry to look to artificial intelligence for help—despite its historically cautious attitude toward tech upgrades. AI‑driven tools are being trialed to manage flight paths, monitor traffic and even assist in cockpit decision‑making, raising both hopes for efficiency gains and concerns about safety, reliability and regulatory oversight.
